notes.title: Bug fix Updates v.2.0.2
notes.content: Fixed a bug that the score may be downloaded before the score is uploaded, and if there is no data to download, it will be forcibly terminated.

notes.title: [ Ver.2.0 UPDATE ]
notes.content:
[ Ver.2.0 UPDATE ]

- Changes in some keywords
- Change enemy graphics / add effects

- Season2 is added to QUICK GAME
  - Added field effect: Enemies and obstacles appear according to the background
  - Compatible with Steam leaderboard: Scores played during login are registered in the online ranking

- Specification change of CUSTOM GAME
  - Supports customs such as ON / OFF of field effects
  - Implemented boss rush as part of custom
  - Implemented a special custom that uses boost seeds
  - To see the weapons registered in the selected aircraft
  - Compatible with Steam leaderboard: Scores played during login are registered in the online ranking

- Added a boss to MISSION MODE
  - Added stage name to MISSION MODE

- Implemented page feed in CUSTOMIZE [LB / LT] [RB / RT] [L-SHIFT] [R-SHIFT]

- Changed the specifications so that boost seeds will appear from PLANTER.

  - Add achievements
  - Supports controller vibration
  - Supports low-speed movement of the keyboard
  - Supports English (some are completely machine translated and will be improved later)
  - Add music

notes.title: Bug fix Updates v.1.1.6 [2021/6/1]
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that forced termination when previewing some weapons on the customize screen.
- Fixed the collision detection of some support weapons because it had disappeared.

notes.title: Multiple Updates v.1.1.3 [2021/2/11]
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that freezes when completing a mission while using a specific weapon.
- Changed to display the [NEW] icon on weapons and archives that have not been confirmed after acquisition.
- Adjusted the balance of some bosses.
- Supported the screenshot function of Steam.

notes.title: XInput related Bugfixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that some keyboard inputs are not accepted when a compatible gamepad is connected.
Supports input when multiple gamepads are connected.

notes.title: UI Bugfix v.1.0.9 [2021/2/6]
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the target display would remain when playing Quick Mode and Customize Mode after Mission Mode.
